positive_global_styles: instrumental cinematic documentary score for a premium YouTube guide about the philosopher Søren Kierkegaard
nineteenth-century Copenhagen atmosphere: Nordic, introspective and literary, candlelit rooms and grey northern light, elegant and modern at the same time
key of D minor, around 86 BPM unless stated otherwise
felt piano, solo cello, warm string quartet and string pads, soft harmonium pad, celesta, distant soft church bells, gentle low percussion, subtle sub bass
mix leaves plenty of space for a spoken voice-over in the mid range

positive_local_styles: cold open in a quiet candlelit room at dusk: a solo felt piano plays a fragile, hesitant melody over a very soft held string note from the very first second
a soft clock-like pulse enters after six seconds; at about twelve seconds a melancholic solo cello line joins
from fifteen seconds the music slowly grows with string pads, like years passing, building gently towards the end
keeps playing at full energy until the very last second, no ending
